indicators.name: IPCA - inflação acumulada no ano
indicators.officialSource: IBGE - Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor Amplo (IPCA)
indicators.notes: 2006-2014, 2024, 2025 carried over unchanged from prior compilation (not re-verified in this session, except 2018 = 3.75 which the IBGE 2019 release cites). 2016, 2017, 2019, 2020 confirmed on IBGE Agência de Notícias pages. 2015 and 2021 confirmed via press coverage of the IBGE Jan-2022 release (2021 = 10.06%, 'maior desde 2015, quando foi 10,67%'). 2022 and 2023 confirmed via press coverage of IBGE releases.

indicators.name: Dívida Bruta do Governo Geral (DBGG)
indicators.officialSource: Banco Central do Brasil - Estatísticas Fiscais, DBGG metodologia a partir de 2008 (SGS 13762)
indicators.notes: BCB concept (not IMF concept, which is higher: ~93% in Dec 2025). VINTAGE CAVEAT: BCB revises the series whenever IBGE revises GDP, and values here come from different publication dates: 2014-2019 from a Ministério da Fazenda presentation (Jan 2022, source BCB); 2020-2021 from press reports of BCB releases (2022-2025); 2022 = 71.7 (BCB vintage of early 2024; first release was 73.5); 2023 = 73.8 (BCB Jan-2025 release; first release 74.3); 2024 = 76.3 (implied by BCB Jan-2026 release: 2025 = 78.7, +2.4 pp; first release was 76.1). 2006-2012 OMITTED: only found inconsistent vintages - BCB Relatório de Inflação 2013 table (2006 56.4, 2007 58.0, 2008 57.4, 2009 60.9, 2010 53.4, 2011 54.2, 2012 58.7; old GDP base, appears to differ in concept) and TCU (2009 61.9, 2010 55.0). Recommend pulling SGS 13762 directly to replace the whole series with one vintage (dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br / api.bcb.gov.br must be allowed in the session network settings).

indicators.name: Resultado primário do setor público consolidado
indicators.officialSource: Banco Central do Brasil - Estatísticas Fiscais (setor público consolidado, exclui Petrobras e Eletrobras)
indicators.notes: 2011-2016 from IFI/Senado RAF4 (May 2017) chart using BCB revised series (new GDP base, Petrobras/Eletrobras excluded retroactively); year mapping inferred from the chart sequence, one decimal only. These differ from first releases (e.g. 2012 first release 2.39%, 2013 1.90%, 2011 3.11%) because of the IBGE GDP base revision. 2017-2025 are BCB year-end release figures (2020 = 9.41% deficit per BCB Jan-2022 note, revised from 9.49%). 2006-2010 OMITTED: only old-vintage/secondary figures found (2006 4.32% at release; BBVA citing BCB: 2008 3.3, 2009 2.0, 2010 2.8) that are not comparable with the revised series. Pull BCB series (SGS 5793 / Estatísticas Fiscais) to fill.

indicators.name: Meta da taxa Selic no fim do ano
indicators.officialSource: Banco Central do Brasil - Copom (histórico das taxas de juros)
indicators.notes: higherIsBetter=false is a convention only; Selic is a policy instrument and arguably should not be graded directly. 2006-2008 from LDO annexes / Lei 12.017/2009 (official). 2013 and 2014 from BCB Relatório Anual 2014. 2015-2016 from a third-party monthly Meta Selic table (dadosdemercado). 2020 = 2.00 inferred (rate held at 2% from Aug 2020 to Mar 2021). 2022 = 13.75 inferred (held from Aug 2022; Copom Feb 2023 maintained it). 2019 OMITTED: Dec-2019 decision (expected cut to 4.50) not confirmed by any source seen. 2026 not included (year not finished).

indicators.name: Taxa de câmbio R$/US$ no fim do ano (PTAX venda)
indicators.officialSource: Banco Central do Brasil - PTAX venda, último dia útil do ano (SGS 1)
indicators.notes: NOT FILLED: no search result in this session showed official year-end PTAX values, and BCB hosts do not resolve from this environment. Only lead found: third-party site numerando.com.br lists PTAX venda 31/12/2025 = 5.5018 (citing BCB) but the same table shows an identical value for 30/12, so it was not used. Fill from BCB SGS series 1 (PTAX venda) taking the last business day of each year; requires api.bcb.gov.br / dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br to be allowed in the session network settings.
